pages.text: The $(item)Inscribing Bier$() is where I carve the rift into my own body.

pages.name: Inscribing Bier
pages.text: 5 by 5 floor, the core between two blocks, candles on the corners.

pages.title: Lying Down
pages.text: I lie down on the slab and the rift shows me my own body, part by part: head, chest, arms, back, legs, feet, skin.$(br2)Each carving asks for things and for essence, taken from the bier, from my body, my vessels, the sources and the altars near.
